one_liner: Pipedrive offers a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and API key authentication for CRM integration.
gating_notes: OAuth 2.0 is required for Marketplace apps; API tokens are available for direct integration. A 14-day free trial is available without a credit card.
oauth_details: OAuth 2.0 is the recommended protocol for public apps. Tokens are retrieved from https://oauth.pipedrive.com. Scopes provide granular access.

auth_methods.quote: Hi, I am an integrator and I am trying to use OAuth and stop using the APITOKEN as authentication method.

primary_auth.quote: Using OAuth 2.0 is necessary for developing apps that are available in the Pipedrive Marketplace.

credential_access.quote: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
